---
title: "RNA-seq-QC"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
# load in multiqc data
QC_raw_full <- read.delim("../output_RNA/raw_qc/multiqc_data/multiqc_fastqc.txt", header = TRUE)
QC_raw <- read.delim("../output_RNA/raw_qc/multiqc_data/multiqc_general_stats.txt", header = TRUE)

colnames(QC_raw) <- str_replace(colnames(QC_raw) , "FastQC_mqc.generalstats.fastqc.", "") 
```

```{r}
QC_raw <- QC_raw %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_replace(Sample, "run-2-", "")) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_replace(sample_id, "_S[0-9]+", ""))

QC_raw_summarized <- QC_raw %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_seq = sum(total_sequences),
    n_fastqs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(total_Mseq = total_seq/1000000)

QC_raw_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq) %>% filter(total_Mseq < 15) 
paste(nrow(QC_raw_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq) %>% filter(total_Mseq < 15))/2, "samples have fewer than 15M reads in each direction")

write.csv(QC_raw_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq), "../output_RNA/raw_qc/multiqc_data/concatenated_runs_nreads.csv")
```


```{r}
# load in multiqc data
QC_trim <- read.delim("../output_RNA/trimmed_qc/multiqc_data/multiqc_fastqc.txt", header = TRUE)
#QC_trim <- read.delim("../output_RNA/trimmed_qc/multiqc_data/multiqc_general_stats.txt", header = TRUE)
```

```{r}
QC_trim <- QC_trim %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_replace(Sample, "run-2-", "")) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_replace(sample_id, "_S[0-9]+", ""))

QC_trim_summarized <- QC_trim %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_seq = sum(Total.Sequences),
    n_fastqs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(total_Mseq = total_seq/1000000)

QC_trim_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq) %>% filter(total_Mseq < 15) 
paste(nrow(QC_trim_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq) %>% filter(total_Mseq < 15))/2, "samples have fewer than 15M reads in each direction")

write.csv(QC_trim_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq) , "../output_RNA/trimmed_qc/multiqc_data/concatenated_runs_nreads_post_trim.csv")
```
